title: Shared Office & Shop Floor — Machinery, Phone Alerts, Breathing & Coworker Calls

source.noise_source: Bundled CC-BY-4.0 VAANI Stems + Procedural Acoustics

transcript_raw: Good morning, I am calling regarding our merchant current account settlement batch from yesterday evening. Yes, our merchant ID is M E R seven seven four one nine, and the settlement amount was forty two thousand six hundred rupees. Usually the NEFT settlement hits our bank account by ten A M every morning, but today it is still showing as processing. Let me check the terminal batch summary receipt right now, give me just a moment while I pull it up on the machine. Okay, the batch number printed on the slip is zero zero eight nine, closed at nine forty five P M last night. Wait, you are saying two UPI transactions in that batch had a timeout reconciliation hold? If those two transactions are on hold, can you release the remaining forty thousand rupees immediately? That works for me. Please initiate the partial release now and send the reconciliation report to our registered email. Also, could you tell me the exact UTR number once the clearing house confirms the transfer? Understood, I see the notification email arriving in my inbox right now with the case reference. One last question, will the two disputed UPI transactions automatically settle tomorrow morning after T plus one verification? Thank you very much for resolving this quickly, I appreciate your assistance today. Goodbye.
